title: The Red Lantern
summary: Narrative survival game about guiding a dog-sled team through recurring wilderness encounters, making choices about routes, resources and the relationships with individual dogs.

observations.statement: The dog-team premise and event-driven journey are central to the experience and were positively received in the available review evidence.
A reviewed player reported journal/completion entries failing to register even after relevant events occurred, creating achievement/progression friction.
The Steam store language table lists English support without official Russian localization.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
